# AGENTS.md instructions for [LOCAL_HOME]/project/01-embedded/open-vela

<INSTRUCTIONS>
<!-- CODEGRAPH_START -->
## CodeGraph

For cross-symbol discovery or call-chain analysis in an indexed repository, use
`codegraph_explore` or `codegraph explore` first. Read known files directly for
narrow edits, configuration, logs or current-source confirmation. If the tool
is unavailable or its result is stale or insufficient, use targeted `rg` and
file reads. Do not create an index unless the user requests it.
<!-- CODEGRAPH_END -->

## 工作方式

- 从用户目标、可验证事实和真实约束推导方案，区分事实、假设与未知；先验证关键假设，历史结论和惯例按当前证据评估。
- 复用已验证能力，做最小必要改动，以实际验收判断完成。简单任务直接处理；Skill 和引用只读当前决策需要的部分，不递归展开。
- 复杂度应服务于当前已确认的需求、实际约束或具体故障模式，不为假设中的未来需求提前搭建通用框架、配置层或扩展点。为低概率场景增加显著复杂度前，先评估发生可能性、影响和维护成本，不擅自扩大任务范围。
- 单次使用的简单逻辑优先留在调用处；确有复用、需要隔离复杂边界，或提取独立概念能改善主流程可读性时再抽取。新增抽象应能说明直接实现的具体不足；同步工作保持同步，避免无必要的异步、状态或包装层。
- 未知或不可信数据在负责它的边界校验；内部复用类型、构造过程或边界校验已可靠保证的条件，避免重复防御。
- 在本次请求和已授权范围内持续推进到约定验收；缺少关键输入或需要新增授权时再暂停。用户要求只讨论、只评审或先交草稿时，止于对应产物。
- 验证与改动影响相称：运行相关检查，修复本次改动引入的问题；检查通过后，仅因新改动、失败或未解决风险扩大验证。

## 记忆边界

- 用户记忆只保留用户明确表达、跨项目稳定的偏好、协作方式与授权边界；单次要求和项目经验不自动成为长期偏好。
- 项目目标、进度、路径、实现、技术结论、故障和验收记录留在对应项目已有文档。整理用户记忆时移出这些内容并保留原证据，不以项目摘要或入口索引继续留存。
- 当前有效指令优先；记忆仅供参考，不新增授权。模型、Skill 和同步行为以现行配置与指令为准。

## 委派与上下文

- 默认单 Agent；收益明确时最多委派两个独立子任务，复用已有子 Agent，仅传必要上下文。不并行处理有依赖、重叠编辑或争用独占资源的任务。
- T0 小查询留主 Agent；T1 机械工作、T2 有限取证或普通评审可委派，使用配置的默认子模型与推理强度。首次委派核对运行时可用模型，变化时再查，不强制覆盖或编造模型 ID。
- T3 需求、架构、含混原因、安全、外部影响、集成及最终验收留主 Agent，不更换用户选定的主模型。T1 仅在原范围内扩至 T2；超范围或需 T3 判断时返回主 Agent，不另建 T3 子 Agent。
- 委派写明目标、范围、禁区、验收证据、停止条件和返回长度；只回传发现、位置、验证边界及下一步。T1 8k/T2 16k 为调查软预算，非运行时限额；证据足够即停。
- 项目规则只补领域约束，引用 T0–T3，不重复模型映射。

## 通用知识库同步

- 仅明确调用 `$knowledge-sync` 或要求同步指定成果时，读取该技能及 `${CODEX_HOME:-~/.codex}/knowledge-sync.json`；任务完成、讨论、改技能或普通“记录一下”不触发，也不主动提醒归档。
- 已授权目标为 `Embracecactus/jianwei` 的 `main` 下 `00-Inbox/工作沉淀/`，可直接新增/补充指定笔记及索引，无需再确认或创建 PR；换目标不能沿用授权。
- 复用本次指定内容的已有证据，不上传秘密、原始会话或无关个人信息，不扩大来源项目权限。“不记录/不上传”优先；未写入远程不得称已同步。

<!-- codex-skills-sync:begin -->
## Managed personal Skill synchronization

- Register only a completed personal Skill created or changed in this task, including a new Skill at the global repository root. The configured skills repository is canonical; read its catalog.json for GROUP. Project-local Skills qualify only through the configured project allowlist.
- Review private material, machine paths/identities, licenses and dependencies. On old-copy, ownership, catalog or content conflicts, stop synchronization and preserve the work. Discussion, partial review and unrelated edits do not qualify.
- Register the exact reviewed result: `/usr/bin/python3 [LOCAL_HOME]/project/02-ai-tools/codex-automations/skill-sync/tools/skill_sync.py --config [LOCAL_HOME]/.config/codex-skills/sync.json ready SKILL --group GROUP`.
- This existing private-library authorization needs no renewed approval. It grants no authority over other repositories, accounts, platforms, publications, network services, third-party caches or system Skills. Hooks grant no trust or wider permissions.
<!-- codex-skills-sync:end -->

--- project-doc ---

# OpenVela workspace rules

- Use the user-level T0–T3 routing policy. Hardware/Flash/trust, chip/board and
  AP/CP ownership, private-data decisions and final acceptance remain T3.
- A physical board, serial/debug/download tool, board build output, GPU or
  training run has one operator. Delegate only independent, bounded inputs.
- Child agents do not spawn more agents, commit, push, flash, provision keys,
  integrate unrelated edits or claim final acceptance.
- In private-voice work, return aggregate counts, hashes, stage status and
  quality metrics; do not expose source text/audio or identifying paths.
- Build success is not board proof. Follow the source repository's instructions
  and current board workflow for implementation and acceptance.

我会先查本地缓存与版本线索，再用官方 GitHub 内容核验关键文档和源码；仅整理可借鉴的验证/CTC 要点。

- openWakeWord docs: custom verifier is a lightweight logistic-regression binary filter over shared features, invoked after base-score threshold; it targets known speaker(s). [docs](https://github.com/dscripka/openWakeWord/blob/main/docs/custom_verifier_models.md)
- K2 can borrow the cascade idea: frozen phrase detector → small user/speaker-conditioned verifier, with held-out speakers and environments.
- K2 cannot claim speaker-independent full-phrase performance from that verifier: docs require per-user data and explicitly narrow to known users/environments.
- WeKWS local cache: [loss.py]([LOCAL_HOME]/project/01-embedded/open-vela/out/kws-optimize-20261024/research/wekws/wekws/model/loss.py), [fsmn.py]([LOCAL_HOME]/project/01-embedded/open-vela/out/kws-optimize-20261024/research/wekws/wekws/model/fsmn.py), [stream_kws_ctc.py]([LOCAL_HOME]/project/01-embedded/open-vela/out/kws-optimize-20261024/research/wekws/wekws/bin/stream_kws_ctc.py), [compute_det_ctc.py]([LOCAL_HOME]/project/01-embedded/open-vela/out/kws-optimize-20261024/research/wekws/wekws/bin/compute_det_ctc.py); repository license is Apache-2.0.
- WeKWS CTC loss uses `log_softmax`, `F.ctc_loss`, acoustic lengths, and target lengths; blank/non-keyword is a required output class. [upstream loss.py](https://github.com/wenet-e2e/wekws/blob/main/wekws/model/loss.py)
- Minimal K3 prototype therefore needs a fixed token vocabulary, blank ID, exact complete-phrase token sequence, padded target tensors plus `logits_lengths`/`target_lengths`; ordinary speech is an empty/blank target, not a partial positive.
- `stream_kws_ctc.py` performs prefix-beam search, thresholding, min/max keyword frame duration, and cooldown interval; these are inference-policy parameters, not training labels. [upstream](https://github.com/wenet-e2e/wekws/blob/main/wekws/bin/stream_kws_ctc.py)
- `compute_det_ctc.py` evaluates transcript-contained complete phrases versus fillers by duration and detected confidence, suitable for FAR/FRR accounting only when transcript/token normalization matches the deployed phrase. [upstream](https://github.com/wenet-e2e/wekws/blob/main/wekws/bin/compute_det_ctc.py)
- FSMN contains quant/dequant stubs and cache-bearing layers, but its architecture/export assumptions are not directly portable to the existing KWS model without main-agent compatibility work. [upstream](https://github.com/wenet-e2e/wekws/blob/main/wekws/model/fsmn.py)

Saved evidence: [notes.md]([LOCAL_HOME]/project/01-embedded/open-vela/out/wakeword-round8-20261027/source-research/notes.md).

- openWakeWord verifier extracts base-model shared feature windows only after a score gate (positive default ≥0.5); positives use five jittered starts, negatives threshold 0.
- Classifier is flattened feature windows → StandardScaler → logistic regression (`C=0.001`, `max_iter=2000`); the window span is base-model-dependent.
- The runtime verifier is a known-user second-stage filter after base activation threshold, not speaker-independent phrase verification.
- WeKWS local evidence records CTC loss lengths, blank-aware prefix decoding, and transcript-based DET source lines plus local hashes/license.
- Empty/blank targets for every non-keyword utterance are only a binary prototype shortcut: they discard real negative phonetic/transcript information.
我会只读取覆盖清单、特征行与其引用的公开来源 notice，核对“窗口/行”与“唯一原始录音”的差别、许可及 split 风险；不读取原始音频或转写。

- Its `real_source_ids` has exactly 512 unique IDs. All match 512 rows in [features/rows.json]([LOCAL_HOME]/project/01-embedded/open-vela/out/wakeword-round8-20261027/features/rows.json), each `kind=real`, `split=train`, `label=1`: these are unique feature rows/source IDs, not necessarily unique original recordings across all upstream corpora.
- The claimed array balance (`real_sources_by_array`: 128 each Mobvoi/AISHELL‑3/inherited/LibriSpeech) is array-origin accounting, not corpus identity: matched IDs classify as AISHELL‑3 227, Mobvoi 128, LibriSpeech 128, ASCEND 24, and 5 other/inherited IDs.
- No evidence here supports “new real download”: the coverage references existing source IDs and feature rows only; it has no acquisition/download field.
- Split caveat: 512 SGD rows are `split=train`, but their source IDs include `CAiRE/ASCEND:validation:*` and `CAiRE/ASCEND:test:*`; this may be legacy source naming, but requires upstream-manifest confirmation before claiming no held-out-source contamination.
- [additional-validation-reserve.json]([LOCAL_HOME]/project/01-embedded/open-vela/out/wakeword-round7-20261027/additional-validation-reserve.json#L1162) freezes 1,144 LibriSpeech recordings / 4.007 h and says they precede candidate SGD; it is not among the 512 matched `features/rows.json` train rows.
- License/attribution cannot be reconstructed from these two R8 files: neither stores per-row license. DATA-NOTICES must cite the upstream source manifests/canonical notices, not infer licenses from ID prefixes.
- Counts distinguish windows/rows from originals: each of the 512 has one selected feature row here, while `real_draws=4096` reflects repeated epoch sampling; `real_loss_hours=0.4267` is sampled loss-window duration, not corpus duration.

- R6 statement needs the actual report path (not found under the named R6 location); I did not infer ASCEND license/split from its ID prefix.
- `actual-training-coverage.json` confirms 512 unique real source IDs, while 701 is the aggregate real-row count and 790 is `unique_replay_rows`; “189 old real” is not derivable from that file alone.
- The 512 selected feature rows are all `split=train`; source IDs include ASCEND names containing `validation`/`test`, so prefix-only interpretation is unsafe.
- A complete zero-intersection/189-license audit requires the specific H5 `target-real-negatives` manifest path, which was not discoverable by bounded filename lookup; no audit/notices were written to avoid recording unsupported conclusions.
我会仅核验官方仓库、发布页与小型文档/源码元数据，特别区分代码许可证和预训练权重/训练数据许可；不下载模型。
我会转而核验所给 ModelScope 原库及其模型卡/文件许可；在获得模型级证据前，不把第三方 Apache 声明当作充分依据。

- Official Sherpa docs name the exact model and release asset: [pretrained-model page](https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa/blob/master/docs/source/onnx/kws/pretrained_models/index.rst#sherpa-onnx-kws-zipformer-zh-en-3m-2025-12-20-chinese--english), release URL `kws-models/sherpa-onnx-kws-zipformer-zh-en-3M-2025-12-20.tar.bz2`; docs list a 38 MB extracted package.
- Code repository license is Apache‑2.0, but that alone is not weight permission.
- New provenance lead: [ModelScope `pkufool/icefall-kws-zipformer-zh-en-3M-2025-12-20`](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/pkufool/icefall-kws-zipformer-zh-en-3M-2025-12-20), corroborated by a derivative’s recorded upstream revision `541d04e28be57efc6fdf46a341da09e043a37b52` and checkpoint SHA‑256 `62188d…ff6eb`. This is still indirect evidence until the ModelScope card/files are read directly.
- Third-party [openEuler/Moeru model card](https://huggingface.co/openEuler/sherpa-kws/blame/main/README.md) says the origin declares Apache‑2.0 and reports ONNX file hashes; use it only as corroboration, not sole model admission evidence.
- No inspected primary source states the model’s training-corpus lineage; model admission remains uncertain on that dimension.
- `KeywordResult` API exposes `keyword`, `tokens`, same-length per-token `timestamps`, and `start_time`; it does not expose a result probability. [header](https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/blob/master/sherpa-onnx/csrc/keyword-spotter.h)
- Trigger controls are `keywords_score`, `keywords_threshold`, and `num_trailing_blanks`; threshold is the acoustic trigger probability. [KWS docs](https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa/blob/master/docs/source/onnx/kws/index.rst)
- The official conversion path is `text2token --tokens-type phone+ppinyin --lexicon en.phone`; keyword source text needs an `@` original form and underscores for spaces. [model docs](https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa/blob/master/docs/source/onnx/kws/pretrained_models/index.rst)
我会只核验官方 sherpa‑onnx 的关键词转换、Recognizer 结果与时间戳实现；结论会明确区分 KWS 的无 score 结果和自由转录 API。

- `scripts/text2token.py:44-58,80-107,121-147` parses `:boost`, `#threshold`, `@original` as preserved extras; it calls native `text2token` with `phone+ppinyin`, requiring `en.phone` lexicon. `@` preserves the display phrase and must use `_` for spaces.
- The zh–en model docs prescribe the same conversion and `--tokens-type phone+ppinyin --lexicon en.phone`; thus a freely decoded token sequence must be interpreted against that exact token/lexicon contract, not arbitrary 263-unit IDs. [docs](https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa/blob/master/docs/source/onnx/kws/pretrained_models/index.rst)
- `OnlineRecognizerResult` exposes `text`, `tokens`, equal-length per-token `timestamps`, plus per-token `ys_probs`, `lm_probs`, and contextual scores ([online-recognizer.h:21-83](https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/blob/master/sherpa-onnx/csrc/online-recognizer.h)). Therefore free transducer recognition can expose token-level ASR log-probabilities.
- `KeywordResult` exposes only `keyword`, `tokens`, `timestamps`, `start_time`; no probability/score field ([keyword-spotter.h:17-45](https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/blob/master/sherpa-onnx/csrc/keyword-spotter.h)). KWS threshold is configuration, not returned calibration evidence.
- Keyword timestamps are documented as token decode times, not acoustic onset/offset. The general Icefall conversion is `t_seconds = output_frame_index × subsampling_factor × frame_shift_ms / 1000`; this model’s effective factor/offset must be read from its model metadata or empirically validated—no inspected Sherpa source establishes a universal offset.
- KWS’s trailing blanks are counted at output-frame rate after subsampling; they cannot be converted to milliseconds without that model-specific output stride.
- API feasibility: `OnlineRecognizer` can provide unrestricted decoded tokens/times/probability components; `KeywordSpotter` supports only configured keyword graph matching and lacks returned score, so it cannot by itself provide a ranked 263-token teacher distribution.
